translated_pages.text:
Sample County Department of Social Services
Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) - Sample County, Virginia
Date: September 28, 2026
Case number: ******4321
Notice of Interview
Your SNAP interview is by phone on October 9, 2026 at 10:00 AM.
We will call you at the phone number we have on file.
Before your interview, please have these papers ready:
- Photo ID for the head of household
- Pay stubs for the last 30 days
- Your lease or a rent receipt
If you cannot keep this appointment, call us at (703) 555-0126 before your interview.
If you miss the interview, your application may be denied.
